persona: Fictional Northriver Lab handbook for synthetic benchmark-v2-eval. Not real people, credentials, or conversations.

items.content: Northriver Lab staff kettle tea is silver needle white tea.
The Northriver weekly design review is Thursday at 14:30 in room D-07.
The synthetic eval project code name is Harbor Lantern.
Northriver cold-storage shelf label for freeze packs is FS-19.
The loaner headset cart lives in closet M-03.
Northriver door PIN for the dry-lab annex is 4827.
The lab supply vendor code on purchase forms is NV-331.
Benchmark audio fixtures are stored under path /synth/audio/harbor.
The Northriver whiteboard marker brand standard is Lumora Blue.
Overnight temperature logger ID for bay 2 is TL-220.
The shared printer queue name is nr-print-west.
Northriver first-aid cabinet location is wall niche beside Stairwell North.
Effective 2026-06-15, Northriver standby GPU sessions may last at most 120 minutes.
Before 2026-06-15, Northriver standby GPU sessions were capped at 75 minutes.
Effective 2026-08-01, the Harbor Lantern nightly backup window starts at 01:15.
Before 2026-08-01, the Harbor Lantern nightly backup window started at 23:45.
Current Northriver shipping dock is Dock B. An older flyer naming Dock A is obsolete.
Obsolete flyer: shipping dock listed as Dock A.
Current evacuation muster point is Courtyard Lamp Post 3. A superseded note named Courtyard Lamp Post 1.
Superseded muster note: Courtyard Lamp Post 1.
Northriver May synthetic-run token budget is 12 US dollars.
Northriver June synthetic-run token budget is 17 US dollars.
Northriver July synthetic-run token budget is 9 US dollars.
Harbor Lantern rehearsal needs rooms D-07 and M-03 reserved together for 90 minutes.
When D-07 and M-03 are co-reserved, operators must also book cart key CK-5.
Visitor tea sample is chamomile citrus; it is not the staff kettle tea.
Closet M-11 stores surplus chairs; it is not the loaner headset cart closet.
Printer queue nr-print-east is a retired alias; do not use it for new jobs.
Draft label FS-07 appears on an unused shelf sketch; the active freeze-pack label is FS-19.
Northriver handbook covers tea, rooms, budgets, and safety labels. No satellite uplink schedule is recorded.
Northriver handbook does not record a preferred pizza topping for lab nights.
No Northriver policy lists a personal mobile-phone unlock code for operators.
Calibration wand serial for Harbor Lantern dry runs is CW-904.
CW-904 may be used only after TL-220 reports temperature within 18–22 C.
Effective 2026-09-01, the dry-lab annex door PIN remains 4827 but must be entered twice for double-check.
Northriver spare headset batteries are charged on cart shelf B; shelf A holds empty cases only.
Beverages: staff kettle uses silver needle white tea. Chamomile citrus stays in the visitor cupboard.
Calendar: design review is Thursday 14:30, room D-07, synthetic agenda only.
Naming sheet: Harbor Lantern is the synthetic eval code name, not a public product.
Cold storage: active freeze-pack shelf label is FS-19. Ignore draft FS-07.
Headset ops: loaner cart in closet M-03. M-11 is chairs only.
Annex access: door PIN 4827. After 2026-09-01, enter the PIN twice.
Purchasing: vendor code NV-331 on all Northriver supply forms.
Fixture paths: synthetic audio under /synth/audio/harbor.
Whiteboard kit: Lumora Blue markers are the standard; other colors are loaner-only.
Bay 2 logger: device TL-220 records overnight temperature.
Print services: active queue nr-print-west. nr-print-east is retired.
Safety: first-aid cabinet is in the wall niche beside Stairwell North.
Compute policy update 2026-06-15: standby GPU sessions max 120 minutes (was 75).
Backup window update 2026-08-01: Harbor Lantern nightly backup starts 01:15 (was 23:45).
Shipping: use Dock B. Discard older Dock A flyers.
Muster revision: gather at Courtyard Lamp Post 3. Lamp Post 1 is retired.
Token ledger: May 12 USD, June 17 USD, July 9 USD for synthetic runs.
Rehearsal checklist: co-reserve D-07 and M-03 for 90 minutes and book cart key CK-5.
Calibration gate: wand CW-904 only after TL-220 shows 18–22 C.
Scope note: handbook has no satellite uplink schedule, pizza preference, or personal phone unlock codes.
